title: Machine learning predicts hospital mortality in sepsis-associated kidney injury
summary: Eleven machine learning algorithms were trained on MIMIC-IV and externally validated in four other ICU databases (27,485 patients in total; hospital mortality 27.5%). A gradient boosting machine was best, with a training AUC of 0.770 and SHAP interpretation. The data are retrospective and discrimination is modest.
ai_technology: Gradient boosting machine with Boruta feature selection and SHAP
organization: Xiaoshan Affiliated Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University

evidence.tested: Prediction of hospital mortality with external validation in MIMIC-III, eICU, NWICU and SICdb.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective database study; modest AUC; clinical benefit not shown; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Gradient boosting model predicting mortality from ICU variables.
